products.short_description: Implement Exchange Online Archiving specifically — archive mailboxes + auto-expanding archive, MRM archive/retention tags, PST import, and litigation/in-place holds — so mailbox size is controlled and messaging data is preserved and discoverable. products.description:
Give mailboxes archiving and holds without the mailbox bloat

Growing mailboxes, PST sprawl, and litigation exposure all point to mailbox archiving. This solution implements Exchange Online Archiving specifically: enable archive mailboxes and auto-expanding archive, move-to-archive via archive/retention tags (MRM), import PSTs to the archive, and apply litigation hold and in-place/eDiscovery holds where required — so mailbox size is controlled and messaging data is preserved and discoverable. (Scoped to email archiving/holds; broader Purview DLP/labels/retention is a separate concern.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — archive mailboxes + auto-expanding archive, MRM archive/retention tags & policies, PST import, and litigation/in-place hold — and how this differs from Purview DLP/sensitivity-label work.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (EXO + archiving-capable licensing, admin roles, PST source if any, legal/records stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — enable archive mailboxes + auto-expanding archive, build MRM archive/retention tags and a policy, import PSTs to the archive, and apply litigation/in-place holds — pilot-first, each policy/tag named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (archives provisioned, move-to-archive working, holds enforced) plus Best Practices; legal-hold determinations deferred to legal/records.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Mailbox bloat controlled and messaging data preserved — archive mailboxes and auto-expanding archive on, move-to-archive tags working, PSTs ingested, holds enforced — discoverable and defensible.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • EXOARCH-Discovery.ps1 — read-only Exchange Online archive/hold posture + mailbox-size assessment. Makes NO changes
    • EXOARCH-EnableArchive.ps1 — enable archive mailboxes (and optionally auto-expanding archive). SAFE BY DEFAULT: reports/-WhatIf unless -Commit
    • EXOARCH-Set-Holds.ps1 — report current holds, and (with -Commit) apply litigation hold from a legal determination. SAFE BY DEFAULT: report/-WhatIf
    • EXOARCH-Set-MrmPolicy.ps1 — create/update the MRM move-to-archive tags + retention policy. SAFE BY DEFAULT: -WhatIf/report unless -Commit
    • EXOARCH-Validation.ps1 — read-only pass/fail validation of archives, move-to-archive, and holds; emits the "Archive Validation - EXO - Report". Makes NO changes

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
